logp.method_description: Distribution coefficient (D7.40) values of selected Cu(II) complexes (1, 5, 6) were determined by the shake-flask method in n-octanol/buffered aqueous solution (20 mM HEPES, pH 7.40, 25.0 ± 0.2 °C). The ionic strength was 0.10 M (KCl) in the two parallel measurements. The compounds were dissolved at 400 µM concentrations in n-octanol pre-saturated with buffer. The stock solution in n-octanol:buffer (1:10) was mixed with 360 vertical rotation for 3 h. After mixing the samples, they were centrifuged at 5000 rpm for 5 min. The two phases were separated and their UV-Vis spectra were recorded, after the dilution of the octanolic phase. The D7.40 values were calculated as follows: D7.40 = (Absoct.phase after separation / Absoct.stock solution) / (1 - Absoct.phase after separation / Absoct.stock solution) × (Vaq.phase / Voct.phase).
